title: All public results
description: Browse completed tournaments, optionally filter by date, and open one event.

steps.title: All results
steps.body: All results lists completed club tournaments. Date filters are optional.

steps.title: Filter from date
steps.body: Set From to limit the list to events on or after that club date.

steps.title: Apply the filter
steps.body: Filter reloads the list. Clear removes the dates.

steps.title: Matching events
steps.body: The list shows completed tournaments in the range, including Tutorial Completed Round Robin.
steps.resultNote: The completed Round Robin remains in the filtered list.

steps.title: Open an event
steps.body: View results opens the public detail page for that tournament.
